system.description: The wilderness works to hide your passage, swallowing footprints and burying your scent beneath earth, tree and grass. Mundane tracking (Survival, tracking dogs) automatically fails to follow you. Supernatural tracking methods (such as Auspex) may still work, but suffer a two-Trait penalty to do so.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book One: Animals
